title.text: Can we derive an algorithm to determine which PV tasks are required for a specific tool based on its context and the PV-eligibility decision?

details.comment: Presently the concepts are more static focus is to define some attributes that isolate a small set of PV-light tasks respectively product-light and rest of the tools are then full product and require full PV tasks but that doesn't sound feasible specially in long run. I personally think, probably there is a process on matter how bad in BSH that discuss with PV what kind of tasks they must do but i think it is inefficient. Here we want to implement a decision tree i think this will be useful for software evaluierung and beschaffung, but most probably there we are going to buy a tool. We can in any case develop a simple decision tree based weight base algorithm
